2610.06100.title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
2610.06100.paper_summary: Realistic environment replicas are increasingly valuable for training and evaluating LLM agents, yet the original systems may be inaccessible or impractical to reproduce. We explore agentic language world modeling: rather than rebuilding an executable environment, a world model agent serves as the environment for a task agent and supports faithful and stateful simulation. We instantiate this paradigm with Trace2Env, a learning-free framework for settings where the original system is unavailable but historical interaction traces remain accessible. Trace2Env reconstructs these traces into a reusable environment worldbook containing environment schemas, grounded evidence, and induced behavioral knowledge. At runtime, the world model agent actively consults the worldbook together with persistent episodic state to infer each action's observation and lasting state effects. Across nine environments, Trace2Env improves both next-observation fidelity and long-horizon interaction consistency over conventional prompt-based LWMs. In multi-turn interaction, task agent actions generated against Trace2Env remain valid more often when replayed in the real environment, indicating that its simulated dynamics better preserve the consequences of earlier actions across successive turns. These results establish agentic language world modeling as an alternative direction for building realistic environment replicas without reconstructing the original executable system.
2610.06100.paper_summary_zh: 現實環境複製品在訓練和評估 LLM 代理方面越來越有價值，然而原始系統可能無法訪問或不切實際地重建。我們探索代理語言世界建模：與其重建可執行環境，不如讓世界模型代理作為任務代理的環境，並支持真實且具狀態的模擬。我們用 Trace2Env 實現這一範式，這是一個無需學習的框架，適用於原始系統不可用但歷史交互痕跡仍可訪問的情況。Trace2Env 將這些痕跡重建為可重用的環境世界書，該書包含環境架構、基礎證據和誘導的行為知識。在運行時，世界模型代理會主動查詢世界書，並結合持久的情節狀態來推斷每個行動的觀察和持久狀態影響。在九個環境中，Trace2Env 在下一觀察的真實性和長期互動的一致性上均優於傳統的基於提示的 LWM。在多輪互動中，對 Trace2Env 生成的任務代理行動在真實環境中重播時更常保持有效，這表明其模擬動態更好地保留了早期行動在隨後回合中的後果。這些結果確立了代理語言世界建模作為構建現實環境複製品的一種替代方向，而無需重建原始可執行系統。
